title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat: Writing blocks edit drafts, memos and emails inline
summary: The briefing accurately separates the roadmap's planned inline editing capability from documented Copilot Chat controls. The app-blocking path and baseline licensing are supported, and targeted searches found no Writing blocks-specific setting, default, or billing rule.

Select Settings, and then select Integrated Apps.

claims.claim: Blocking the Copilot app through Integrated Apps is a broad Copilot Chat access control, not a switch for Writing blocks alone.
